about: Hints about signing in to the large platforms and webmail, for web/signin.py. Data, not code: the generic logic decides, these only start it from facts. A site not listed here is handled by the generic logic alone; a hint that turns out wrong is dropped for that site on the person's computer. account_cookies are cookie names (never values) that a site sets only for a signed-in account: their presence alone is the session. Gathered by visiting each site signed out from a fresh profile (a page or two, nothing typed) and from the sites' own help pages; 'seen' says what that visit showed. messages: where a signed-in account's private messages, replies, mentions, notifications or mail inbox live ('what' says which), most wanted first, for web/inbox.py; written from the sites' help pages and their long-standing addresses as of messages_checked, not visited signed in, and given only where the address is stable (a site whose messages open only as a pop-up has none, and is read at its front page).

sites.signed_in: the avatar at the top right (.header-avatar-wrap) and 动态/消息 counts
sites.signed_out: a round 登录 button at the top right (.header-login-entry)
sites.prompts: a sign-in box after a few minutes of playback, or on pressing like, coin or comment; it closes with its × and playback goes on
sites.open: video pages play (lower quality), search, popular and rankings, comments are readable
sites.walls: liking, coins, comments, watch later, history, following feed, higher quality and member-only episodes
sites.check: geetest image or slide check at sign-in
